text:
Maya: Quick thought: add a 'quiet mode' for automatic fallback notifications at rollout time. The operator inbox is drowning in 1-2 minute blips during noisy deploys. We need a way to suppress chatter without losing forensic detail.

Ravi: Agree. Requirements: 1) keep a complete audit trail (no dropped events). 2) let operators opt out on a per-route basis. 3) expose why snooze was applied (system rule/override).

Jon: Proposed minimal API change: add `notification_mode` + `snooze` object to the rollout policy:```json
{
  "auto_fallback": true,
  "notification_mode": "summarize", // "every_event" | "summarize" | "none"
  "snooze": {
    "by": "system",
    "duration_sec": 600,
    "reason": "spike-mitigation"
  },
  "record_events": true
}
```
`record_events:true` guarantees we write the raw fallback events to the audit store; `summarize` toggles inbox behaviour.

Lina: Important edge: if the underlying error rate remains elevated for >Y minutes we must cancel the snooze and surface each fallback. Otherwise we blind oncall to sustained regressions. Suggest auto-cancel rule: cancel when rate >= baseline*1.5 for >5min.

Patrice: Might want a "sticky unsnooze" too: if an operator manually unsnoozes, never auto-reapply for that rollout instance. Also log who unsnoozed.

Maya: UI notes: - In Rollouts > Active show a muted bell icon + tooltip. - Click opens compact timeline (last N suppressed events) and an explicit "Unsnooze" button. - Audit timeline link always visible (go-to-playback).

ops-bot: [audit] fallback.snooze_applied route=payments-checkout duration_sec=600 by=system ts=1789991234 id=evt_8921

Jon: Telemetry plan: emit a `fallback_snooze_summary` metric per window with tags: route, rollout_id, snoozed_by, suppressed_count, window_start, window_end. And keep `fallback_raw_event` stream for forensic playback.

Ravi: Add these rollout-level fields to telemetry: `snooze_applied_by`, `snooze_reason`, `snooze_duration_sec`. Product will use them to populate timeline and filters.

Lina: Alerting: replace N per-fallback alerts with a single 'suppressed-errors' alert that triggers when `suppressed_count > T` OR when suppressed_error_trend is rising. Include a link with event ids to open the playback UI.

Patrice: Backwards compatibility: keep `notification_mode` optional and default to "every_event". We'll need a migration doc for customers who rely on inbox impulses.

Jon: Tests: unit for schema change, e2e that creates a synthetic spike and asserts summary metric emission and suppressed events are in audit store, UI snapshot for snoozed pill + unsnooze flow.

Maya: Next steps: Jon to open schema PR and the telemetry spike, Lina to propose the exact cancel thresholds with rationale, Ravi to draft UI copy + mockups, Patrice to write the migration note and operator docs. I'll file the three tickets and assign.

Jon: I'll take the PR. Will also add a small integration test that replays suppressed events via the audit playback endpoint.

Maya: Thanks all. Leaving this thread pinned to the rollout-UX board. :white_check_mark:
